subject: Example for multivariate spatio-temporal data modeling

messages.author: bb0d51bd5af5ac0d
messages.subject: Example for multivariate spatio-temporal data modeling
parts:
Hello everyone, 

As a newbie to INLA, I studied the examples in book: Spatial and Spatio-temporal Bayesian Models with R-INLA, which shows univariate space-time model as well as joint modeling of multiple distributions for spatial data. But my actual use case is to deal with multivariate space-time data and I'm not sure how to order/group the data structure when modeling as a whole with INLA. Is there any example code to model multivariate space-time data with R-INLA? 

First and most important, I want to make sure INLA could handle such a model, if it does, then I could go into details how to model my multivariate spatio-temporal big data.

Any input/suggestion would be appreciated!
